text: Entry 1285 adds DiscardOfflineMsg. The accepted implementation skips the mbox DeleteMessages path because it could rewrite headers at a corrupt storeToken, and instead leaves the bytes for later compaction. Other stores receive a best-effort deletion whose failure is ignored. This is a scoped corruption-recovery decision; it does not guarantee immediate physical removal or successful compaction. No damaged mailbox or Maildir deletion was exercised, and discussion is pending.
title: Discarding an offline copy clears the database link without rewriting an untrusted mbox offset
